[sub]An Erene2000 Roleplay[/sub]]

[i]"Kashkent Tower, this is Joker One requesting permission to take off."

"Takeoff approved, Joker One. Have a happy flight, Captain."

"Thank you, Tower. Over and out."[/i]

Captain Erkin jerks back as he launches his RS-35 down the tarmac and lifts off. He is a fighter pilot for the Air Forces of Kyratov, and the Komesk (Squadron Commander) of Joker Squadron. He pulls the stick back and begins to soar into the sky; before long, he is flying high above the ground. His flight today is a simple aerial patrol; Erkin is getting used to his new RS-35, an upgrade from his old RS-33 airframe.

His flight takes him high into the sky, where he can see the entirety of the Kashkent area. He also sees the magnificent sunset from 33,000 feet above the ground and flies into the night. It's about an hour and a half after he takes off that the first signs of trouble are spotted.

[i]"What the h*ll?"[/i] he thinks to himself. [i]"Kashkent Tower, this is Joker One. I am witnessing a large gunfight to the east of Naborsk; there are tracers flying into the distance. How received? Over."[/i]

[i]"Good reception. We acknowledge your report. We will verify. Wait for tasking. Over."

"Acknowledged, Kashkent. Joker waiting for task. Out."[/i]

Each second that passes feels like an hour as Erkin looks over his left shoulder to see tracers fly into the heavens. A large explosion is seen in the distance.

[i]"Joker One to Kashkent Tower, I have just seen a large explosion in the distance. I am positive that the fighting is taking place at Naborsk Military Base. How received? Over."[/i]

[i]"Affirmative, Joker. The combat you are witnessing is at Naborsk. Kyratov Ground Forces are under attack by friendly forces; situation unclear. Blue on blue. I repeat, blue on blue. Joker One, you are ordered to RTB at Kashkent Field and prepare for possible combat operations. How received? Over."[/i]

[i]"Good reception and acknowledged, Kashkent. Joker One RTB. Over and out."[/i]

[i]"What the f*ck? Who's attacking?"[/i] Captain Erkin thinks to himself. He pulls back on the stick, points the nose of his aircraft toward Kashkent, and hits the afterburners.

------------------

[i]"Axiom, I am pinned down over here and need immediate support. These bastards have got my number."

"Received, Axiom. Stay low and stay alive. Red Squad is moving to assist you. How is Anton?"

"Anton is 200. I will be as well if you're not here soon."[/i]

Gunfire hits the ground all around Jasur (codename Axiom) as he takes cover behind a wall. His friend, Anton, lies dead less than ten yards away from him. Jasur has no idea what is happening, but he is glad he had watch tonight. There are plenty of others who were caught out without a weapon. He knows by the amount of fire being poured on them that the enemy must either have access to their armory, or they were prepared to storm a military base. A smoke grenade lands at his feet and pops; the smoke builds around him.

[i]"Run, you dumb bastard, if you want to live."[/i]

He knows that voice; it's that of his Kombat (battalion commander). He doesn't need to be told twice. He runs straight toward it and into a nearby barracks building. He is relieved to find that he is no longer alone.

[i]"What do you know, Axiom?"[/i] the Kombat asks.

[i]"Nothing, sir. I was patrolling an alleyway with Anton when the attack began. He's 200 now."[/i] Jasur responds.

[i]"Sh*t. Okay. I've got some men spread about this house. Our enemies are the 4th Brigade. I don't know why they're our enemies, but they rammed the gate with a BTR and poured in behind it."[/i] The Kombat says with a stern tone. [i]"Find a spot in this building and sit tight. Our best chance of survival is a rescue."[/i]

That statement sends a shiver down Jasur's spine, but he grits his teeth and does as he is told. He moves to take a position on the fifth story of the barracks building. He passes a handful of armed and unarmed soldiers on his way up the stairs. Once he reaches the fifth floor, he can see the gate. He arrives at his window just in time to see an L-90 roll into the base. He reaches down to get on his radio, it's been shot. No wonder he never heard anything after he yelled into it earlier. He stands and prepares to run down the stairs to tell the Kombat. [b][i]BOOM[/i][/b]. The world around him turns foggy, and he is thrown to the ground. Glass and rock land all around him. He is dazed, confused, and his head is killing him. He reaches up and touches his head; blood rolls down his arm. He feels lightheaded. He can't stay awake. He closes his eyes and drifts away.

------------------

The citizens of Naborsk have a front-row seat to the fighting at the Naborsk Military Base. From their homes, many can see tracers flying into the air and explosions in the distance. Crowds of people gather in the street to try and figure out what is going on. It isn't long before the town is swarming with soldiers and militiamen. These men are part of the rebelling army, but none of the civilians know that yet. In the Mir-1 Apartment Complex, the Tursunov family worries about their son Jasur, but they can't leave their house for fear of the fighting. There is a knock at the door; it's another military family.

The family tells them that they ran into a soldier on the street and asked about the situation at the base. They were told simply that:

[i]"There is an active situation at the military base. The enemy is attacking us, but the situation is under control."[/i]

The family was skeptical of the answer, so they asked who the enemy was, but they were just given the runaround. They said that they don't know what is happening, but that you can see the fires raging from their balcony. Before too long, they leave. The Tursunovs watch as the night grows later and later and more soldiers pour into the town. Eventually, the sounds of fighting at the military base die down; they are instead replaced by the sounds of fighting outside of town. The Tursunovs trust in their son's safety and go to sleep for the night.

The next morning, a large plume of black smoke can be seen rising above the military base. Marat and Feruza Tursunova begin their walk up to the military base. What they find shocks them. There are burnt-out vehicles on the road to and from the base, bloodstains litter the road from the night's fighting, and more. They both think that the scene reminds them of a post-apocalyptic movie, like the soldiers were fighting zombies.

They finally reach the gate. Marat walks up to the guard.

[i]"Soldier, do you know where my son is?"

"I'm sorry, sir, I cannot answer specifics on soldiers' whereabouts right now. Many were hurt last night."

"What happened?"

"The situation is still developing, sir, but the enemy attempted to attack last night. They were repelled."

"Who are the enemy?"

"Enemies of the state, sir. That's all I can say right now."

"Okay, but can you please tell me if my son, Jasur Tursunov, is alive?"

"I'm sorry, sir. He's not in my unit. I don't know."

"Can I please go in to check on him?"

"No, sir. In fact, I think it's better that you and your wife leave. Now."

"I am not leaving until I know how my son is. Please, tell us where we can find our son."[/i]

The soldier groans and looks at his partner. [i]"Watch these old folks."[/i] He walks away from the gate and can be seen talking into a radio. He walks back over. [i]"Your son was wounded in the fighting last night. He is resting in the infirmary, but he is in custody. He is an enemy of the state and is considered a prisoner of war."[/i]

The Tursunovs are shocked. Marat shouts, [i]"MY SON IS A PATRIOT. HE WOULD NEVER BETRAY THIS NATION. I OUGHTA-"[/i]

Before he is able to finish his sentence, the soldier raises his gun and points it at him. [i]"I've told you about your son. Now leave, or you can join him, if you're lucky."[/i]

[i]"I see. You're the enemy."[/i] Marat says. He grabs his wife's arm and walks away. He is a fifty-six-year-old man and presently unarmed. There isn't much he can do to help his son, but he now knows that he's alive. That is enough for now, at least. He hears the soldiers laughing behind him as he walks away. 

[/spoiler]
